title: Petra and the Contact
author: Beatrix Almeida
blurb: Rosalind Voss, a private security contractor guarding clients nobody trusts, has spent three years following rules that keep getting rewritten. Then a burner phone that shouldn't exist starts ringing with a familiar voice on the line — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must extract a defector who may be the bait before the markets open in Frankfurt.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
